svg.title: Architecture of polaris
svg.desc: A browser signs in through Cloudflare Access to the polaris Worker in your Cloudflare account. The Worker asks Access for its keys, to check the token of the sign-in, and for the person who signed in. The Worker serves the dashboard app and reads usage from the GraphQL Analytics API, and the names of resources, the Cron Triggers, and the subscriptions from the Cloudflare API, with a read-only API token that it keeps as a secret. pnpm stack:deploy on your machine creates the Access application and the Worker, and puts the token in the Worker.
svg.text: then reads usage when a page opens
the keys and who signed in
creates or updates the Access application and the Worker,
puts the API token in the Worker as a secret,
and tags them as one stack (Resource Tagging)
